svg.title: Contribution arcade
svg.desc: 26 Oct 2025 — 30 Oct 2026. 3,135 calendar contributions; 355 days with activity. Beneath the complete calendar, a decorative pixel bot collects clues, passes an inspection station and delivers a parcel through a portal. The bonus loop illustrates a side quest; it does not depict live activity. A bot message rotates daily. Activity includes automation and any private contribution totals the owner shares publicly. Reduced motion preserves a still scene.
